head: b30597f49aad99032781c251b41a9de886cce3be
reason: The original exact flip-count gate is valid only for weeks that successfully consume public runTurn.nextState. The scenario loop also has a peace/transition branch that calls legacy runOneTurn and can write controllers and create OOB afterward. That state has not passed the public war pipeline's reconciliation, session seal, and post-turn invariant barrier, so its existing scenario repair must remain.

source_evidence.finding: When state.meta.phase is peace, the runner calls runOneTurn, replaces state from result.state, may call applyMunicipalityControllersFromMun1990Only on peace-to-war transition, synthesizes a report, and may create OOB formations. This branch does not call or assert success from public runTurn.
Only the else branch calls public runTurn, assertTurnSuccess, and consumes runResult.nextState. The T1/T2 A/B/C evidence covers this branch.

The optional breach-control writer and the shared repair call occur after both branches. A global flip-count-only condition would therefore skip repair after an unsealed legacy transition whose controller/OOB writers are not represented by applyControlFlipProposals.applied.

required_state: Initialize a deterministic per-week boolean, for example consumedSuccessfulPublicWarTurn, to false before the peace/public branch.
Set it true only in the public runTurn branch after assertTurnSuccess(runResult) succeeds and the successful nextState is accepted.
Initialize a deterministic per-week appliedScenarioControlFlips count to zero before the optional breach-control block and capture applyControlFlipProposals(...).applied when invoked.
exact_amended_scope.call_condition: Invoke repairScenarioArtifactState exactly once when !consumedSuccessfulPublicWarTurn || appliedScenarioControlFlips > 0.
behavior_by_branch: Legacy peace/transition runOneTurn week: preserve the existing repair invocation. If the state remains peace, the helper's existing phase guard keeps it a no-op; if it transitions to war after municipality controller/OOB writes, repair remains available exactly as before.
Successful public runTurn week with appliedScenarioControlFlips === 0: skip the extra repair.
Successful public runTurn week with appliedScenarioControlFlips > 0: invoke repair once with operational OSID edges.
unchanged_exclusions: Do not trigger the public-branch repair from OOB occurrence, created-formation count, baseline activity, generic A-to-B differences, week number, or opportunity presence.
Do not change runOneTurn, runTurn, the helper algorithm/export, native/desktop consumers, final-save projection/session/seal, mechanics, data, thresholds, schema, or saves.

required_focused_legacy_coverage: A real or maintained focused peace-to-war scenario test must prove the legacy branch calls runOneTurn, applies its configured municipality-controller path when present, performs OOB creation as configured, and still invokes repair exactly once with operational OSID edges after those writes.
The resulting war state must pass existing state-shape, friendly-territory, operation-lifecycle, front/sector-truth, and save/observer consistency checks.
A peace week that remains peace must preserve behavior; the shared call may occur but repairScenarioArtifactState must return through its existing non-war guard without state mutation.
Public runTurn tests must separately pin zero-applied => zero helper calls and positive-applied => exactly one helper call.
Final-save projection/session/seal coverage remains distinct and unchanged.
authorization: GO for the branch-scoped caller-only implementation above. The unamended global flip-count-only condition is not approved.
